tool.name: AlphaGenome ISM Scanner
tool.description: Perform in-silico saturation mutagenesis using AlphaGenome API
tool.help:
# AlphaGenome ISM Scanner
Perform in-silico saturation mutagenesis (ISM) using AlphaGenome's API.
## What it does
For each region in the input BED file:
1. Creates a prediction window encompassing the region 2. Scores all possible single-base substitutions (3 per position) 3. Converts results to tabular format
## Output columns
- `region`: Region name from BED - `position`: Genomic position of the mutation - `mutation_index`: Index of the alternate base (0-2) - `gene_id`: Ensembl gene ID - `gene_name`: Gene symbol - `output_type`: RNA_SEQ, ATAC, etc.
## Compute cost
Each region generates **3 x width** API calls. Start with small regions to verify results.
